name: preview-hidden-snap-workflow
description: Preview panel runs hidden (rAF throttled to 0, screenshots time out) — use the window.__snap POST /snap workflow instead
metadata:
  type: project
---

The Claude Preview browser for this project runs with `document.hidden === true`, so `requestAnimationFrame` never fires and `preview_screenshot` times out (~30s). The game is fine; only verification is affected.

**Why:** Hidden pages get rAF throttled to zero and the compositor produces no frames, so the animation loop and screenshot capture both stall.

**How to apply:** Use the hooks already built into [index.html](../../CascadeProjects/photo-realistic-first-person-survival-game/index.html): `window.__snap(yaw, pitch, width)` forces a render (sizing the 0×0 canvas to 1280×720 if needed) and returns a JPEG data URL; POST it to `/snap` (handled by `devserver.py`, launch config "wildwood"), which writes `snap.jpg` in the project root — then Read that file. `window.__dbg` exposes scene/renderer/sun/hemi/camera/player for live tuning via preview_eval.
